use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Point = (x: double, y: double)

let subject =
    [(x = 50.0D, y = 150.0D), (x = 200.0D, y = 50.0D),
     (x = 350.0D, y = 150.0D), (x = 350.0D, y = 300.0D),
     (x = 250.0D, y = 300.0D), (x = 200.0D, y = 250.0D),
     (x = 150.0D, y = 350.0D), (x = 100.0D, y = 250.0D),
     (x = 100.0D, y = 200.0D)]

let window =
    [(x = 100.0D, y = 100.0D), (x = 300.0D, y = 100.0D),
     (x = 300.0D, y = 300.0D), (x = 100.0D, y = 300.0D)]

side(at: Point, from: Point, to: Point) -> double =>
    (to.x - from.x) * (at.y - from.y) -
    (to.y - from.y) * (at.x - from.x)

crossing(first: Point, second: Point, from: Point, to: Point) ->
        Point =>
    (let near = side(first, from, to)
     let far = side(second, from, to)
     let part = near / (near - far)

     (x = first.x + (second.x - first.x) * part,
      y = first.y + (second.y - first.y) * part))

same(a: Point, b: Point) -> bool => a.x == b.x /\ a.y == b.y

extend(kept: LIST[Point], at: Point) is
    if kept.count == 0 \/ !same(kept[kept.count - 1], at) then
        kept.add(at)
    fi
si

clip(polygon: Collections.List[Point], from: Point, to: Point) ->
        LIST[Point] is
    let kept = LIST[Point]()

    for index in 0..polygon.count do
        let previous = polygon[(index + polygon.count - 1) %
                               polygon.count]
        let at = polygon[index]

        let here = side(at, from, to) >= 0.0D
        let before = side(previous, from, to) >= 0.0D

        if here != before then
            extend(kept, crossing(previous, at, from, to))
        fi

        if here then
            extend(kept, at)
        fi
    od

    if kept.count > 1 /\ same(kept[0], kept[kept.count - 1]) then
        kept.remove_at(kept.count - 1)
    fi

    return kept
si

let clipped mut = LIST(subject)

for index in 0..window.count do
    clipped =
        clip(clipped,
             window[index],
             window[(index + 1) % window.count])
od

write_line("clipped polygon of {clipped.count} points:")

for at in clipped do
    write_line("    ({at.x:F3}, {at.y:F3})")
od

let image = IMAGE(520, 520)

image.view(20.0D, 20.0D, 380.0D, 380.0D)

closed(polygon: Collections.List[Point]) -> LIST[Point] is
    let ring = LIST(polygon)

    ring.add(polygon[0])

    return ring
si

image.colour(210ub, 232ub, 214ub)
image.fill(clipped)

image.stroke(2.0D)

image.colour(180ub, 60ub, 60ub)
image.line(closed(subject))

image.colour(70ub, 70ub, 180ub)
image.line(closed(window))

image.colour(30ub, 120ub, 60ub)
image.stroke(2.6D)
image.line(closed(clipped))

for at in clipped do
    image.dot(at.x, at.y, 4.0D)
od

image.write("clipped.png")

image.show("clipped.png")

use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Point = (x: double, y: double)

let subject =
    [(x = 50.0D, y = 150.0D), (x = 200.0D, y = 50.0D),
     (x = 350.0D, y = 150.0D), (x = 350.0D, y = 300.0D),

     (x = 150.0D, y = 350.0D), (x = 100.0D, y = 250.0D),
     (x = 100.0D, y = 200.0D)]

let window =
    [(x = 100.0D, y = 100.0D), (x = 300.0D, y = 100.0D),
     (x = 300.0D, y = 300.0D), (x = 100.0D, y = 300.0D)]

side(at: Point, from: Point, to: Point) -> double =>
    (to.x - from.x) * (at.y - from.y) -
    (to.y - from.y) * (at.x - from.x)

crossing(first: Point, second: Point, from: Point, to: Point) ->
        Point =>
    (let near = side(first, from, to)
     let far = side(second, from, to)
     let part = near / (near - far)

     (x = first.x + (second.x - first.x) * part,
      y = first.y + (second.y - first.y) * part))

same(a: Point, b: Point) -> bool => a.x == b.x /\ a.y == b.y

extend(kept: LIST[Point], at: Point) is
    if kept.count == 0 \/ !same(kept[kept.count - 1], at) then
        kept.add(at)
    fi
si

clip(polygon: Collections.List[Point], from: Point, to: Point) ->
        LIST[Point] is
    let kept = LIST[Point]()

    for index in 0..polygon.count do
        let previous = polygon[(index + polygon.count - 1) %
                               polygon.count]
        let at = polygon[index]

        let here = side(at, from, to) >= 0.0D
        let before = side(previous, from, to) >= 0.0D

        if here != before then
            extend(kept, crossing(previous, at, from, to))
        fi

        if here then
            extend(kept, at)
        fi
    od

    if kept.count > 1 /\ same(kept[0], kept[kept.count - 1]) then
        kept.remove_at(kept.count - 1)
    fi

    return kept
si

let clipped mut = LIST(subject)

for index in 0..window.count do

             window[index],
             window[(index + 1) % window.count])
od

for at in clipped do
    write_line("    ({at.x:F3}, {at.y:F3})")
od

image.view(20.0D, 20.0D, 380.0D, 380.0D)

closed(polygon: Collections.List[Point]) -> LIST[Point] is
    let ring = LIST(polygon)

    ring.add(polygon[0])

    return ring
si

image.fill(clipped)

image.stroke(2.0D)

image.line(closed(subject))
